sources.title: An Invariant of Regular Isotopy
sources.source_type: complete published research article, author-hosted image scan
sources.publication_or_version: Transactions of the American Mathematical Society 318(2) (1990), 417-471
sources.read_pages: PDF pp. 2-56, the entire article; printed pp. 417-471. PDF p. 1 is a JSTOR cover/notice.
sources.coverage: Complete body read from OCR; visually checked PDF pp. 15-17 and 51-54 (printed pp. 430-432 and 466-469).
useful_locators: §II, printed pp. 420-429: regular-isotopy L and writhe-normalized F
§III, printed pp. 430-437, especially pp. 430-432: bracket definition, state expansion, curl correction and Jones substitution
§V, printed pp. 448-452: regular isotopy and embedded bands/framed links

§VII, printed pp. 466-469: Dubrovnik convention and omitted L-to-D conversion proof

sources.title: Combinatorial Knot Theory and the Jones Polynomial
sources.coverage: Complete PDF and references; visual checks of diagram-heavy pp. 38-43.
useful_locators: §2, pp. 3-11: bracket axioms, RII/RIII discussion, curl factors and writhe normalization
§2 state sum, pp. 11-13: bracket state expansion
§3: Vassiliev and perturbative quantum discussion

sources.title: The Fundamental Theorem of Vassiliev Invariants
useful_locators: §1: singular knots, finite-type order, chord diagrams, 4T/FI and fundamental theorem statement
§2: weight systems and Kontsevich geometric approach, KZ flatness and configuration-space integrals
§2.5 and §2.5.1 onward: Kontsevich integral definition, finiteness and needle estimates
limitations: Topological integrability route is left as a conjecture/problem.
Kontsevich geometric route is a proof sketch, not a complete analytic proof of convergence, isotopy invariance and universality.

sources.arxiv_comment: Main text (54 pages); Auxiliary Lemmas and Proofs (7 pages); Figures (17 panels). Comments are welcome

sources.coverage: Complete v1 text and references; no later version existed in the API result at 2026-10-18 11:33 UTC.
sources.claimed_result: Every nontrivial knot has a nonzero Jones-Vassiliev coefficient f_q for some 2 <= q <= 3 c(K); hence Jones polynomial detects the unknot.
sources.status_assessment: Dated major theorem claim; not independently audited or locally reproved here. Do not treat as an established local supplier. No immediate contradiction found in complete text/selected diagram read; absence of journal_ref/DOI fields is neither proof nor disproof.
exact_external_audit_focus: Proposition 5.12 machine geometry, especially the auxiliary-shadow cap B_aux <= B_host + 12 versus machine overhead kappa=11
Uniform collapse to at most four clasp crossings and at most two machine loops after smoothing a residual anti-parallel twist crossing
Smoothing proxy and disjoint two-machine locality (G8)
useful_locators: Theorem 6.8 and proof, PDF pp. 50-52: quantitative triviality barrier N <= 3 c(K)
Theorem 6.9, PDF p. 53: claimed Jones unknot detection
Proposition 5.12, PDF pp. 38-48: geometric clasping-twist machine
limitations: Single posted v1 in arXiv API at 2026-10-18 11:33 UTC; no journal_ref/DOI metadata fields returned.
Claim is not imported as a supplier without independent local proof justification.

normalization_contracts.name: Repository HOMFLYPT
normalization_contracts.braid_formula: P(closure beta)=u^{e(beta)} alpha^{n-1} tr_n(pi_n(beta)); P(unknot)=1; P(empty)=uz separately.
normalization_contracts.correction: m is not inverted in R; alpha=(l^{-1}-l)/m holds only in R[m^{-1}].

normalization_contracts.name: Jones bracket
normalization_contracts.state_sum: sum over states S of A^{a(S)-b(S)}(-A^2-A^{-2})^{|S|-1}.
normalization_contracts.diagram_caveat: For the crossing as drawn in Kauffman 1990 printed p. 430, A smoothing is the horizontal pairing and B smoothing is the vertical pairing; switching the crossing interchanges the coefficients. Local diagrams must make this explicit and calibrate the oriented positive crossing.

normalization_contracts.name: Dubrovnik/Kauffman
normalization_contracts.skein: D_+ - D_- = z(D_0-D_infty); positive and negative curl factors a,a^{-1}; circle value 1.
normalization_contracts.conversion: D_K(a,z)=-i^(-w(K))(-1)^(c(K))L_K(ia,-iz), i^2=-1; source prints proposition but omits proof.
normalization_contracts.local_bmw_caveat: BMW convention uses z=q-q^{-1} and relation z(delta-1)=rho-rho^{-1}; reconcile signs/parameters locally.
normalization_contracts.oriented_L_normalization: F_K(a,z)=a^{-w(K)}L_K(a,z), Definition 2.4, PDF p. 7 = printed p. 422.

proof_obligations: Provide local A/B crossing and smoothing diagrams; prove bracket RII/RIII invariance and the separate writhe correction for R1.
Prove bracket/TL closure-trace equivalence under the same parameter dictionary; existing Jones specialization does not itself prove TL trace descent.
Promote and audit TL trace descent; it is draft and cannot serve as a supplier.
For Kauffman/BMW, reconcile skein sign, curl, circle and parameter relations, then separately prove spanning, uniqueness of descending tangle representatives and linear independence.

Keep generic ribbon functor (framed invariant) separate from scalar-twist Markov correction (unframed invariant); explicitly prove the quantum-group/RT trace agrees with the Hecke or bracket realization before identifying polynomials.
For a general 3-manifold skein module, define the framed-link coefficient module and local quotient; do not assume freeness.

For root-of-unity TQFT, prove the negligible quotient, fusion data, finite-dimensional surface spaces, handlebody basis, nondegenerate gluing pairing and surgery/Kirby-color invariance; distinguish the result from Chen's restricted surface TV scope.

For finite type, define singular-knot derivative and framing convention; derive 4T and FI; prove Kontsevich integral convergence, critical-point invariance/normalization, and associated-graded universality rather than cite the 1997 sketch.

Treat Carmi-Cohen 2026 result as a dated claimed solution until its machine-geometry proof has independent scrutiny and local proof justification; it does not prove finite-type invariants distinguish all pairs of knots.
